description: Create a task in weclapp, e.g. "clarify delivery date with customer". Required: subject. Optional: description (plain text), due_date (YYYY-MM-DD), start_date, priority (LOW, MEDIUM, HIGH; default MEDIUM), customer_id (links the task to the customer), sales_order_id (links it to the order), assignee_user_id (default: the weclapp user the API token belongs to), fields. Visible to the whole organisation. WRITES into the customer's ERP — it goes through the permission gate and the weclapp write log.

fields.description: Field values to set (API field name → value)

name: create_weclapp_task
